auth.notes: Cookie set by server on first GET /. Also uses Cloudflare (cf_clearance). No API key. No CSRF. curl_cffi with chrome impersonation should pass Cloudflare.

captcha.note: cf_clearance cookie present. curl_cffi with chrome124 impersonation typically bypasses Cloudflare JS challenge. No interactive CAPTCHA observed.

get_address.notes: Returns the current session email address. Called on page load.

get_seconds_left.notes: Returns time remaining in seconds. Polled every 30s.

reset_session.notes: Adds 10 more minutes to the session. GET only.

expired.notes: Called by client when timer hits 0. No-op for our purposes.

get_messages.notes: index is 0-based message count offset. Returns array of new messages since that index. All messages returned on first call with index=0.

reply.notes: Reply to a message by id.

forward.notes: Forward a message to another address.

notes: Clean REST API with PHP cookie session. The email address and domain are assigned by the server on first GET /. We cannot choose the address — only use what the server gives. Multiple domains available (vtmpj.com seen, likely more). Implementation: create cli_10mm.py, cookie session restored from cache.
